skill_description.crossroads: Crossroads of the swarm: records the decisions of the user, the swarm and the juries as a navigable graph with their discarded options, rationale and impact; ties them to commits split by concern; when the project is stuck, finds the upstream decision, reads its brief and proposes a reversal on a new branch. Use it when the user decides between options, changes course, asks why something was decided, or wants to go back to an earlier fork.

skill_arguments.crossroads: [derive | show ID | radius ID | brief ID | plan ID | …]

help:
EXTENSION crossroads: the decision graph and the way back
  crossroads <command>         derive | check | decide | note | stage | realize | trailers | show | changes | lint
                               | radius | brief | plan | apply | verify | check-commits (`crossroads --help`)
record_dprime: record the new decision first, with decide … --supersedes, then derive
stale_plan: stale plan: its inputs changed since plan.json; run plan again
dry_run: dry run: add --execute only after the user's explicit yes (it creates a branch, never merges)
record_exists: error: this record already exists (same bytes, same id)
evidence_words: warning: --evidence takes space-separated ids or <anchor>/<path> refs, not free text; these words will be DANGLING: {words}
